clarification: Historical layout novelty is not required. A scene may reuse historical geometry, and incomplete historical layout coverage does not block SGW release.
eligibility_condition: The layout must satisfy the current ablation's physical, within-study distinctness, counterbalance, source/runtime and recording requirements; historical use neither qualifies nor disqualifies it.

superseded_clause.scope: Supersedes only the requirement to reject historical-layout duplicates. The distinct-layout requirement within the new SGW cohort is retained.

preserved_requirements: Distinct SGW layouts within the registered cohort, including reset-tolerance duplicate checks.
Frozen candidate caps, counterbalance, allocation and physical qualification criteria.
Preservation of every existing valid failure and partial or infrastructure attempt.
Historical episodes remain historical: no relabeling, replacement or pooling into new SGW evidence.
Current asset, source, model, reset, runtime, resource and recording identities remain required.
RoboLab only and full benchmark qualification first; no exploratory policy shortcut.
operational_effect: Stop historical-novelty audits as a release prerequisite. Keep existing historical inventories and audit records as optional provenance; do not delete them or falsely mark their coverage complete.
